feedback_summary: The response is placed in Band 1 due to severe grammatical breakdown and inaccuracies in data reporting. While the candidate successfully identifies the main trend (Coal being the highest), the inclusion of numbers not present in the source material and the high density of linguistic errors make the script nearly incoherent in parts. The structural attempt is present but fails to provide a professional analytical description.
